title: The Palace Voice
hero_prompt: A bold linocut print of a single carved wooden hand mid-stroke, cutting a clean straight line through a tangle of ornate curling flourishes — the flourishes falling away like wood shavings, the line left behind plain and unbroken. Strong black ink, visible gouge texture, warm cream paper.
icon_prompt: A bold linocut icon of one straight thick black line cutting cleanly through a small curl, high contrast, no fine hatching, reading instantly as plain-line-over-ornament at 24px.
